title: Hi, I'm looking for the name of a movie I watched years ago.

commenti.body:
Your main post is all horizontal with a scrollbar. What's up with that?

"At the beginning of the film, the family is moving to a new house, the mother and two daughters. They move to this big house that is the inheritance of a relative who died and the film develops, until two criminals in a van invade the house and murder the mother and lock up the two girls and then pretend to be her mother, one of them, who is the protagonist, dreams of being a successful writer while delirious she thinks about having fulfilled this dream but is just delusional and does not distinguish between reality and fiction, at the end of the film the protagonist's sister convinces her that she is delusional and face real life challenges and then they try to escape but the criminals end up being killed by the police"

----

I dunno, that sounds like such a strange plot that you'd think it would be extra-memorable. What decade did it appear to be filmed in?

I'm pretty sure this is the movie Ghostland / Incident in a Ghostland (2018). 

"At the beginning of the film, the family is moving to a new house, the mother and two daughters. They move to this big house that is the inheritance of a relative who died and the film develops, until two criminals in a van invade the house and murder the mother and lock up the two girls and then pretend to be her mother, one of them, who is the protagonist, dreams of being a successful writer while delirious she thinks about having fulfilled this dream but is just delusional and does not distinguish between reality and fiction, at the..." (to fulfill comment length requirement)
Not OP, but... Sounds about right.
